instruction: Using GIMP, open 'character.png' from the Desktop and convert it to grayscale (remove all colors). Export the grayscale image as 'character_gray.png' to the Desktop.

metadata.explanation: Task requires converting character.png to grayscale using GIMP's Image > Mode > Grayscale feature. Evaluator checks that the result image has all RGB channels equal (no color information).
